parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version of the detection points. An exact search is performed. Valid values:

- IPv4: This version is applicable when the target address is an IPv4 address.

- IPv6: This version is applicable when the target address is an IPv6 address.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the health check template. A fuzzy search is performed based on the keyword that you enter.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol used for detection. An exact search is performed. Valid values:

- ping

- tcp

- http

- https
